title: Milton Friedman - The Real World Effects Of Unions
summary: An 11-minute clip of Milton Friedman explaining the incentives of unions and how they affect employment. He argues unions restrict labor supply, raising pay for some workers while hurting low-skill workers.
why: HN commenters share it in union threads as a concise statement of the free-market economist's case against unions.

quote.text: Great short explanation from Milton Friedman
